name: C2PA 임시 신뢰 목록(Interim Trust List, 2026-01-01 동결)
note: P0R-21: the root anchors of the frozen Interim Trust List used by verify.contentauthenticity.org (its header: Content Credentials signed with certificates chaining to these stay valid, but validators should distinguish them from those chaining to the official C2PA Trust List).
